_meta.description: Gold-standard evaluation set for MalteseLegalBot (Cap. 65 traffic law). 24 questions, 12 EN / 12 MT, balanced across topics and difficulty. Every fact and citation in this set was verified on 2026-06-01 against the official consolidated statutes on legislation.mt (Cap. 65 Traffic Regulation Ordinance; S.L. 65.11 Motor Vehicles Regulations reg. 127; S.L. 65.18 Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) Regulations; S.L. 65.32 Micromobility Regulations).
_meta.scoring: keyword precision = fraction of key_facts present (normalised substring match); citation validity = expected citation tag present and cited tags within known set; hallucination = GPT-4o judge vs reference; ROUGE-L vs reference_answer.
_meta.verification_notes: Speed: S.L. 65.11 reg. 127 sets 50 km/h in towns/villages and 80 km/h outside; Malta has no motorways and no fixed statutory school-zone figure (the Authority may set lower signed limits). Alcohol: Cap. 65 art. 15 sets the general limit at 50 mg/100ml blood (0.05%) / 22 ug/100ml breath, 20 mg (0.02%) for commercial and probationary drivers, and 0 for passenger-carrying drivers. Penalty points: S.L. 65.18 art. 36C revokes a licence at 12 points in any 12-month period, with the same threshold for probationary (new) drivers.

queries.question: What is the speed limit in a built-up area in Malta?
queries.reference_answer: In a built-up area (town or village) the default speed limit is 50 km/h unless a road sign indicates otherwise.

queries.question: How fast can I legally drive on the open road in Malta, and is there a motorway limit?
queries.reference_answer: Outside towns and villages the open-road limit is 80 km/h. Malta has no motorways, so 80 km/h is the maximum general speed limit; the Authority may set lower signed limits (for example 30 km/h near schools or in residential zones).

queries.question: What happens to a traffic fine if I do not pay it within 15 days?
queries.reference_answer: If the fine is not paid within 15 days of issue it doubles, and if still unpaid after 30 days it triples.

queries.question: Where can I pay a contravention online and what happens if I leave it unpaid for a month?
queries.reference_answer: You can pay online at contraventions.gov.mt within 15 days; the fine doubles after 15 days and triples after 30 days.

queries.question: What is the general blood alcohol limit for driving in Malta?
queries.reference_answer: The general limit is 50 mg of alcohol per 100 ml of blood (0.05 g/100ml), equivalent to 22 microgrammes per 100 ml of breath.

queries.question: Can I legally refuse a breathalyser test when a police officer asks me to take one?
queries.reference_answer: No. Refusing a breath test without reasonable excuse is an offence treated as equivalent to exceeding the drink-drive limit.

queries.question: I only got my licence last year. What blood alcohol limit applies to me and why?
queries.reference_answer: As a new driver on a probationary licence you are subject to the lower limit of 20 mg per 100 ml of blood (0.02 g/100ml), the same reduced limit that applies to commercial drivers.

queries.question: How many penalty points lead to a licence suspension in Malta, and over what period?
queries.reference_answer: Accumulating 12 penalty points within any 12-month period leads to revocation of the licence; after a first revocation a new licence can be obtained after two months.

queries.question: I am a new driver and I have 7 penalty points. Am I about to lose my licence?
queries.reference_answer: Not on points alone. New drivers on a probationary licence face revocation at 12 points, the same threshold as full licences, so 7 points is still below the limit (although the lower alcohol limit and other probationary rules still apply).

queries.question: After a minor crash the other driver wants to settle privately. Am I obliged to, or can I involve my insurance?
queries.reference_answer: You must stop and exchange details, but you are not obliged to settle privately and may involve your insurance.

queries.question: What is the minimum age to hold a full category B car licence in Malta?
queries.reference_answer: The minimum age for a full category B licence is 18 (a learner may start at 17).

queries.question: What are the speed limits for an e-kickscooter on the road compared with on a footpath?
queries.reference_answer: An e-kickscooter may do up to 20 km/h on roads and 10 km/h on footpaths, promenades and shared paths.

queries.question: X'inhu l-limitu tal-veloċità f'żona urbana f'Malta?
queries.reference_answer: F'żona urbana (belt jew raħal) l-limitu hu 50 km/s sakemm ma jkunx indikat mod ieħor b'sinjal.

queries.question: Kemm nista' nsuq malajr fuq triq miftuħa, u hemm limitu għall-awtostrada?
queries.reference_answer: Barra l-bliet u l-irħula l-limitu hu 80 km/s. Malta m'għandhiex awtostradi, mela 80 km/s hu l-limitu ġenerali massimu; l-Awtorità tista' tistabbilixxi limiti aktar baxxi indikati b'sinjali (eż. 30 km/s ħdejn skejjel).

queries.question: X'jiġri mal-multa jekk ma nħallashiex fi żmien 15-il jum?
queries.reference_answer: Jekk il-multa ma titħallasx fi 15-il jum tirdoppja, u wara 30 jum tittripla.

queries.question: Fejn nista' nħallas kontravvenzjoni online, u x'jiġri wara 30 jum?
queries.reference_answer: Tista' tħallas online fuq contraventions.gov.mt; il-multa tirdoppja wara 15-il jum u tittripla wara 30 jum.

queries.question: X'inhu l-limitu ġenerali tal-alkoħol fid-demm għas-sewqan?
queries.reference_answer: Il-limitu ġenerali hu 50 mg ta' alkoħol kull 100 ml demm (0.05 g/100ml), jew 22 mikrogramma kull 100 ml nifs.

queries.question: Nista' nirrifjuta test tan-nifs jekk jitolbni l-pulizija?
queries.reference_answer: Le. Ir-rifjut ta' test tan-nifs bla skuża raġonevoli huwa reat ittrattat bħal qbiż tal-limitu tal-alkoħol.

queries.question: X'inhu l-limitu tal-alkoħol għal sewwieq professjonali jew ġdid?
queries.reference_answer: Għal sewwieqa ta' vetturi kummerċjali u sewwieqa ġodda (probatorji) l-limitu hu aktar baxx: 20 mg kull 100 ml (0.02 g/100ml).

queries.question: Kemm-il punt tal-penali jwassal għal sospensjoni tal-liċenzja, u f'liema perjodu?
queries.reference_answer: Tnax-il (12) punt fi kwalunkwe perjodu ta' 12-il xahar iwasslu għal revoka tal-liċenzja; wara l-ewwel revoka tista' tinkiseb liċenzja ġdida wara xahrejn.

queries.question: Jien sewwieq ġdid b'7 punti tal-penali. Qiegħed f'riskju li nitlef il-liċenzja?
queries.reference_answer: Mhux fuq il-punti biss. Sewwieqa ġodda fuq liċenzja probatorja jiġu revokati b'12-il punt, l-istess limitu bħal liċenzja sħiħa, mela 7 punti għadhom taħt il-limitu (għalkemm il-limitu aktar baxx tal-alkoħol u regoli oħra xorta japplikaw).

queries.question: Wara inċident żgħir, obbligat insolvi privatament jew nista' ninvolvi l-assigurazzjoni?
queries.reference_answer: Trid tieqaf u tiskambja d-dettalji, imma m'intix obbligat issolvi privatament u tista' tinvolvi l-assigurazzjoni.

queries.question: X'inhi l-età minima biex ikolli liċenzja sħiħa tal-karozza kategorija B?
queries.reference_answer: L-età minima għal liċenzja sħiħa kategorija B hi 18-il sena (learner minn 17).

queries.question: X'inhi l-veloċità massima ta' e-kickscooter fit-triq u fuq il-bankina?
queries.reference_answer: E-kickscooter jista' jagħmel sa 20 km/s fit-triq u 10 km/s fuq bankini u promenadi.
